pieces.Text: A creature struck by a vavakia's tail slap must make a DC
Fortitude save or be stunned for 1 round. On a critical hit, the stun effect lasts for 1d4 rounds on a failed save, and 1 round on a successful save. The save DC is Constitution-based.
